triage.kind_span: issuer tender offer subject to Rule 13e-4.

subject_names.span: Eaton Vance Senior Income Trust (Name of Subject Company (Issuer))

subject_tickers.span: The Shares are traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “EVF.”

security_class.span: Common Shares of Beneficial Interest, $.01 par value

price_basis.span: The price to be paid for the Common Shares is an amount per share, net to the seller in cash, equal to 99% of the net asset value per share as of the Expiration Date

price_pct_nav.span: equal to 99% of the net asset value per share as of the Expiration Date

nav_pricing_date.value: close of regular trading of the NYSE on the date the Offer expires
nav_pricing_date.span: Shares will be purchased at 99% of the NAV of the Shares as of the close of regular trading of the NYSE on the date the Offer expires, July 30, 2021

size_pct_outstanding.span: to purchase for cash up to 60% or 22,719,965 shares of its outstanding common shares

expiration_date.span: The Offer expires on July 30, 2021 at 5:00 p.m., Eastern Time, unless the Fund extends the Offer.

proration.span: If more Shares than the Offer Amount are properly tendered and not withdrawn prior to the Expiration Date, the Fund will, upon the terms and subject to the conditions of the Offer, purchase the Offer Amount on a pro rata basis (disregarding fractional shares)

spans: The purchase of Shares in the Offer would result in the delisting of the Shares from the NYSE.
The Offer could impair compliance with U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission or Internal Revenue Service requirements.
In the Board’s reasonable judgment, there is a material legal action or proceeding instituted or threatened, challenging the Offer or otherwise potentially materially adversely affecting the Fund.
The suspension of or limitation on prices for trading securities generally on the NYSE, other national securities exchange or NASDAQ.
The Board determines that the purchase of Shares might be a breach of its fiduciary duty.

The purchase of Shares in the Offer would result in a failure to comply with the applicable asset coverage requirements applicable to any senior securities of the Fund that are issued and outstanding.

trigger_origin.span: EVM and Saba entered into an agreement (the “Agreement”) pursuant to which EVM recommended to the Board, and the Board authorized, the Offer and the three conditional tender offers discussed below

notes: Initial SC TO-I (issuer tender, 60% of shares at 99% of NAV on expiration date) with Offer to Purchase and Letter of Transmittal.
